headline: Sunday's four hours cost you less than they should have - the rest day did exactly what it was there for.
body:
Monday's numbers - this morning's sync has not landed yet, so I am reading yesterday's - show **7.7 h sleep with 91 min deep**, the deepest single night in the 29-day window, against 55 min the night before. HRV came in at **58 against a 61.4 mean**: one morning under, which is the normal dip after **96.83 km and 1,775 m**, not a warning. Amber. Take today as written and nothing extra.

Pool 2,000 m - 400 warm-up, 4 x 300 off 30 s, 400 easy. Hold **2:00-2:05/100 m**, which is **6:00-6:15 per 300**, against the 2:04/100 m you swam on 1 September. Do not read heart rate in the water; it lies. PM is the last Legs of the block - light, nothing heavy.

The brick run still has no file after three syncs, so it is not coming. Give me the split and the heart rate off the bike.

Ride tomorrow's 3 x 8 min early: **34 km/h gusts before 11:00 against 50 by evening**.
